snying dkar bstan pa dang / thal gong rgyas/ stobs glang po ches mi thub/ nang du mngon par shes pa ci rigs pa 'char/ mgrin par brtan pas lce 'phel nas gdong gi dkyil 'khor khebs/ ro bro ba dang smra mkhas/ rtsod pa sus kyang mi thub/ spyi bor brtan pas/ spyi gtsug cung zad mtho/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i dri ma las grol/ bskal pa gcig la sogs pa mi 'chi ba'i tshe la dbang thob/ rdzu 'phrul ci rigs ston nus/ yang dang po la bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin chung / gnyis pa la 'bring / gsum pa la chen po/ bzhi pa la chen po'i yang chen por 'gyur ro/ /de'i mthar mthong ba'i lam gyi ye shes skye'o/ /grub mtha' bde stong rgya che ba ni/ sa phyed dang bcu gsum la 'khor 'das thams cad ro gcig stobs dang mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi yon tan phal cher 'byung ba yin no/ /'da' ka ma lam phyag rgya chen po nas 'pho ba ni/ sbyang ba goms pa/ las la sbyar ba gsum mo/ /dang po sbyang ba ni/ rlung gi sbyang ba ste/ de yang nyi ma gang zla ba nyer/ yang rung ba mi mchod gcig la la srog rtsol gyi rlung khug pa bcu bdun thun bzhi'i nges pas bya/ de bzhin du nyi ma re re la rlung khug pa re re bskyed la/ zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du sbyang / tha ma srog rtsol gyi rlung khug pa so bdun du 'gyur ro/ /de nas nyi ma re re zhing khug pa re re bri bas khug pa nyi shu rtsa gcig pa sngar gyi tshad du 'gyur ro/ /de ltar zhag bzhi bcu zhe gnyis su sbyangs pa las rgyu ba gsal ba dang rnam pa nges par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa goms pa la gnyis las/ sgra la goms par bya ba ni/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag rnams sngon du song bas/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i dmigs pa dang 'dren pa'i gnad shes pas lan bcu'am nyi shu'am nyer gcig gi bar du nyams dang sbyar ba thun bzhi'i rim pa zhag bdun du goms par bya'o/ /gnyis pa yi ge la goms la'ang gnyis las/

phyi'i yi ge la goms pa ni yi ge dgod pa'i gnas rnams su gdan zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re sgom/ de rnams kyi steng du yi ge dgod/ 'og sgo nas rnam par shes pa thon na dmyal bar 'gro bas de dgag pa'i don du k+ṣ+mar+yu dmar po mgo gyen la lta ba bsgom/ gci ba'i lam nas thon na dud 'gror skye bas yaṃmar+yu sngon po mgo gyen du lta ba lte ba nas thon na/ 'dod khams kyi lha rigs drug tu skye bas k+ṣuṃ dkar po/ kha nas thon na/ yi dwags su skye bas sum̐ dkar po/ sna nas thon na dri zar skye bas yum ser po/ rna ba nas thon na mi'am ci la sogs par skye bas yum sngon po/ mig nas thon na mir skye bas hūm̐ sngon po/ mig dang rna ba la sogs pa'i sgo de dag g.yas nas rgyal po/ g.yon nas thon na phal par skye/ smin mtshams nas thon na gzugs khams kyi lhar skye bas samarayuṃ dkar po spyi gtsug nas thon na gzugs med du skye bas/ hamarayuṃ dkar po'o/ /rkyang pa'i yi ge rnams sgril ma'am/ mgo sprod kyi bar du bzla dang bcas pa'o/ /yi ge thams cad 'od dang gzi brjid dang dpal gyis mdzes pas rnam par shes pa gang du'ang mi ster bar bsam/ gnyis pa nang gi yi ge la/ goms pa ni/ 'khor lo bzhi la dgod pa'i yi ge tsaṇ+ḍa li bzhin du bsgom/ rtsa g.yas g.yon gnyis su a li dkar po mgo gyen la lta ba re re dang / ka li dmar po mgo thur du lta ba gnyis gnyis spel mar bkod pas rtsa g.yas g.yon gnyis dgag de'ang rtsol ba'i dus su mas yar gsal gdab/ srog gi dus su yas mar gsal gdab pa'o/ /de'ang thun bzhi'i rim pa zhag bdun du goms par bya'o/ /gsum pa las la sbyar ba la bzhi/ bde 'gro la sbyar/ gling dang skyes gnas gzhan la sbyar/ grong gzhan la sbyar/ lam phyag rgya chen po la sbyar ba'o/ /dang po ni/ sngon 'gro bum dbang gi 'da' kha ma bzhin bya ba'am/ ma byas kyang rung / lus tsog pur bya/ phyi'i sgo yi ges dgag

gang du 'gro bar 'dod pa'i gnas de'i yi ge bsal la bzhag snying rjer rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du zla ba/ de'i steng du rnam shes kyi rten hūm̐ sngon po gcig gsal gdab/ hi ki nyi shu tham pas mgrin pa'i bar du rang nyi shu rtsa gcig pas sgo de nas 'phangs pa'i rten 'brel gyis gang 'dod pa'i gnas der skye'o/ /gnyis pa gling dang skye gnas gzhan la sbyar ba ni/ yi ges sgo dgag pa la sogs pa sngon 'gro sngar bzhin bya/ spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i sgo bsam/ snying kha'i rlung dang zla ba hūm̐ dang bcas pa sngar bzhin bsams la hi ki nyi shus mgrin pa/ rtsa gcig pas spyi gtsug nas gton te/ bde ba can dang mngon par dga' ba la sogs pa'i gling dang / rdzus te skye na rin po che dang pad+ma la sogs pa'i skye gnas dang / mngal du skye na rgyal rigs dang / bram ze la sogs pa'i mngal yid la byas te 'phangs na de dag tu mi skye mi srid do/ /gsum pa grong gzhan la sbyar ba ni/ dug dang mtshon dang rim gyis ma shi ba/ 'gegs pa'am chur shi ba/ sems can gyi don nus pa'i ro gtsang ma rnyed na dri zhim pa'i chus bkru/ gu gul gyi dud pas bdug lhar bskyed/ yi ges sgo dgag gnas gsum bsrung / mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i mchod pa bya/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom/ rlung gi nus pa che na mdun du bzhag kyang 'grub/ nus pa chung na yang du blangs la dar ram ras kyi shang mas mi 'chug par bsdam/ bdag dang rten gnyis ka'i sna sgo'i yi ge bsam/ de nas bdag gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las rlung phyir rgyu ba'i rtse mor ras 'di'i rtser mar me 'bar ba lta bu'i sogs kyi ngo bo hūm̐ sngon po 'od 'bar ba gcig bsams la/ rlung nang du 'jug pa'i tshe hūm̐ med rlung rkyang pa drang / phyir rgyu ba'i tshe sngar bzhin hūm̐ dang bcas pas bton la rten gyi snying kha'i hūm̐ la stim/ de lta bu mang du byas pas rten de'i snying khar drod 'byung mig 'byed 'dzum shes/

rlung cung zad rgyu ba la sogs pa 'byung / de'i tshe sems gcig gis rten gnyis bzung ba'i dus zhes bya/ de nas drag por byed na hi ki nyi shus mgrin pa'i bar du drang zhing / rtsa gcig pa la sna bug g.yas nas phyungs la rten gyi sna sgo g.yon nas snying khar 'phang / zhi bar byed na rtsol ba nyid kyis rten sems kyi rten mgrin pa'i bar du drang zhing phul la/ stsol ba tha mas sna g.yas nas bton te/ rten de'i g.yon nas bcug snying khar bzhag ste srog 'dzugs pa dang bral bar byas na nges par las la sbyar te 'grub bo/ /de nas drin lan bsam pa'i phyir rten rnying pa de sbyang ba dang / mchod rten la sogs pa sgrub bo/ gsar pas sems can gyi don rgya chen po bya'o/ /bzhi pa lam phyag rgya chen po nas 'pho ba ni/ lus skyil krung rtsog pur bya/ phyi nang gi yi ges sgo dgag pa ni sngar dang 'dra/ de nas rlung phyir rgyu ba'i dus su rtsa dbu ma'i phyi dbyibs kyi a nas spyi gtsug gi ham̐ gi bar dran par bya/ rlung nang du 'jug pa'i dus su gam̐ spyi gtsug gi haṃ nas a'i bar dran par bya/ de ltar yang dang yang du bsgoms pas/ gzung 'dzin gyi rtsa ba srog stsol gyi rlung dbu mar thim nas bde stong mchog gi ting nge 'dzin skye la/ de lam dus kyi lta ba dang 'dres nas bar do med par mchog gi dngos grub 'grub bo/ /de la dang po gsum ni dbang bzhi ka'i thun mong yin la/ 'di ni thun mong ma yin pa yin no/ /'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku rang bzhin lhun grub ni 'bras bu'i skabs nyid du 'chad do/ /lam la sogs pa chos nyi shu bstan zin to/ /gang zag dbang po rab tshe 'di la sangs rgyas/ 'bring 'pho ba'i rten 'brel gyis 'chi dkar/ de 'og bar do'i rten 'brel gyis bar do nyid la/ tha ma dam tshig dang sdom pa'i rten 'brel gyis skye ba bdun dang bcu drug la sogs pa na 'grub bo/

/de la skabs 'dir bar do'i gdam ngag gsung bas de bshad na/ dbang bzhi dang 'brel ba'i bar do bzhi las/ thog mar bum dbang gi bar do la gnyis te/ sngon 'gro sbyang ba dang / dngos gzhi bar do'i rnal 'byor dran pa'o/ /dang po ni/ kha zas la sogs pa dus nges pa dang / 'jigs pa dang bag tsha ba la sogs pa dus ma nges pa dang / gnyid du 'gro khar 'dun pa drag pos skyed de dran pa gsum nyams su blangs pas/ rmi lam du 'jigs pa la sogs pa byung ba'i tshe rnam pa gsal na grub pa yin no/ /de la dran pa gsum ni/ dbang bskur ba thob pa'i bla ma/ des bstan pa'i yi dam gyi lha/ de dang 'brel ba'i gsang mtshan gsum mo/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ bar do'i dus su 'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi ni/ sa chu la thim pa'i rten 'brel gyis ri bo rab tu 'grum pa'i sgra/ chu me la thim pas bskal pa 'jig pa'i rgya mtsho 'khrug pa'i sgra/ me rlung la thim pas dus mtha'i me'i sgra/ rlung rnam par shes pa la thim pas dus mtha'i rlung gi sgra'o/ /nyams nga ba'i g.yang za ba gsum ni/ ngan song gsum du 'gro ba'i g.yang za ba'i lam ston pa'o/ /de dag gi rten 'brel gyi skyabs gzhan med pa sngar gyi dran pa gsum mi 'byung mi srid do/ /de'i tshe dri za ba yin pas/ dri kha dog gi tshul du 'byung bas kha dog lnga'i de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i ngo bor shes la/ bar skabs der yi dam gyi lhas lung bstan nas bar do de nyid la rig pa 'dzin par la sogs par 'gyur ro/ /gal te bdud kyang lha'i gzugs su bdag la lung ston pa srid pas/ gsang mtshan gsang zhing ma rjed pa dang / dbang bzhi'i brda la goms pa gnad du che'o/ /gnyis pa gsang dbang gi bar do ni/ sngon 'gro gsang dbang gi bla ma/ lam bdag byin brlabs/ lta ba rang 'byung gi ting nge 'dzin gsum sbyang / dngos gzhi 'jigs pa'i rkyen bdun byung ba'i tshe/ gsang dbang gi chos gsum dran/ snam bya a li ka li la sogs pa rtsa yi ge'i rnam par mthong /

des rkyen byas nas/ rang 'byung gi ye shes rtogs nas nying mtshams sbyor ba med par 'dzin pa la sogs par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi bar do ni/ sngon 'gro ni dbang gsum pa'i bla ma/ lam dkyil 'khor 'khor lo/ lta ba lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes gsum goms par byas pas dngos gzhi 'jigs pa'i rkyen bdun byung ba'i tshe/ dbang gsum pa'i chos gsum dran/ snam bya byang chub kyi sems kyi rnam par mthong / des rkyen byas nas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rtogs nas nying mtshams sbyor ba med par rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs par 'gyur ro/ /dbang bzhi pa'i bar do ni/ sngon 'gro dbang bzhi pa'i bla ma/ lam rdo rje rba rlabs/ lta ba shin tu rnam par dag pa'i de kho na nyid gsum goms par byas pas dngos gzhi 'jigs pa'i rkyen bdun byung ba'i tshe/ dbang bzhi pa'i chos gsum dran/ snam bya yang ye shes kyi rlung gi rnam par mthong / des rkyen byas nas chos thams cad shin tu rnam par dag pa'i de kho na nyid phyag rgya chen po'i ting nge 'dzin rtogs nas bar do de nyid du grub mtha' snyogs pa'am/ rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /de dag gis lam la sogs pa chos nyi shu bar do dang bcas pa bstan zin to/ /gsum pa dam tshig gi tshogs bstan pa la gnyis las/ dam tshig ji ltar bsrung ba'i tshul ni/ mnyam gzhag gi dam tshig sogs bsrung zhes bya ba ste/ 'di la don rnam pa lnga/ dam tshig rnams kyis rnam grangs bstan pa/ mi nyams par bsrung ba'i tshul/ nyams pa'i nyes dmigs/ bsrung ba'i 'thad pa/ bsrungs pa'i phan yon no/ /dang po ni dbang re re la lnga lnga ste/ mnyam gzhag gi dam tshig rjes spyod kyi dam tshig bza' ba'i dam tshig bsrung ba'i dam tshig mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig go /dang po bum dbang gi mnyam gzhag gi dam tshig bskyed rim/ rjes spyod kyi dam tshig ngo bo nyid gsum/ bza' ba'i dam tshig sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i ril bu/

bsrung ba'i dam tshig rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig gi nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig rdo rje dril bu'o/ /gsang dbang gi mnyam gzhag gi dam tshig bdag byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa/ rjes spyod kyi dam tshig rang 'byung gi ye shes so/ /bza' ba'i dam tshig gsal stong gi ting nge 'dzin/ bsrung ba'i dam tshig rlung dang 'gal ba mtha' dag mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig rlung zhi drag gang rung ngo / /shes rab ye shes kyi mnyam gzhag gi dam tshig dkyil 'khor lo/ rjes kyi dam tshig lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes/ bza' ba'i dam tshig bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin/ bsrung ba'i dam tshig 'dzag pa bsrung ba/ mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig dngos po ye shes kyi phyag rgya'o/ /dbang bzhi pa'i mnyam gzhag gi dam tshig lam rdo rje rba rlabs/ rjes spyod kyi dam tshig shin tu rnam par dag pa'i de kho na nyid/ bza' ba'i dam tshig bde stong mchog gi ting nge 'dzin/ bsrung ba'i dam tshig yod med la sogs pa gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa mtha' dag mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig dngos sam ye shes kyi pad ma can no/ /gnyis pa mi nyams par bsrung ba'i tshul la bzhi las/ tshul ji lta ba bzhin skyongs pas bsrung ba ni/ dam tshig gi rnam grangs rtogs pas gnyen po skyes te nyes pa thams cad rang grol du 'gyur ba'o/ /gnyis pa rnam grangs rjes su dran pas bsrung ba ni/ dam tshig nyi shu po ngag tu brjod cing yid kyis bsams la/ nyes pa ma byung na dga' ba bsgom/ byung na bshags te/ ri dwags kyi rgyal po seng ge lus bsrung ba bzhin no/ /gsum pa ting nge 'dzin gyi skyes pas bsrung ba ni/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i de kho na nyid lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin phyin ci ma log pa gcig skyes pa na nyes pa thams cad las rang grol bar 'gyur te/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che rnyed na phongs pa'i sdug bsngal las grol ba bzhin no/ /bzhi pa bla ma mnyes pas bsrung ba ni/

gsang sngags kyi bla ma mnyes pas bsrung ba ni/ gsang sngags kyi bla ma yang dag pa gcig la bcos ma ma yin pa'i phyir/ mos gus rkang gi khong nas skyes nas rtsa ba dang yan lag gi nyes pa thams cad las grol par 'gyur te/ rgyal po mnyes na khrims kyi nyes pa las grol ba bzhin no/ /gsum pa nyams pa'i nyes pa la gnyis las/ bum dbang gi dam tshig nyams na srid pa'i sdug bsngal 'dren par 'gyur la/ dbang gong ma gsum gyi dam tshig nyams pas lam bgrod pa la yun ring du 'gor ba yin no/ /bzhi pa bsrung ba'i 'thad pa ni/ mnyam gzhag gi dam tshig rnams ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyu yin pas bsrung ba 'thad/ rjes spyod kyi dam tshig rnams ting nge 'dzin dngos yin/ bza' ba'i dam tshig rnams de'i mthun rkyen/ bsrung ba'i dam tshig rnams 'gal rkyen spong ba/ mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig rnams ting nge 'dzin/ bzang po'i grogs yin pas bsrung bar 'thad do/ /lnga pa bsrung ba'i phan yon ni/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrungs pa la rten nas 'byung bas so/ /gnyis pa nyams na bshags pa'i tshul la gnyis te/ bshags pa'i brten dang / bshags pa'i tshul thabs shes/ dang po ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro la sogs kyi thugs dam bskang / zhes bya ba'i don ni/ mkha' 'gro lnga mnyes par byas te/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni bla ma sogs kyi sgras/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ni longs sku/ ma mo mkha' 'gro sprul sku/ sha za mkha' 'gro dur khrod kyi bdag yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma/ po la sogs pa/ dam tshig mkha' 'gro ni dbang bskur ba thob la ma nyams pa'i rdo rje spun grogs so/ /gnyis pa bshags pa'i thabs la gnyis las/ thog mar rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams na bskang ba'i thabs ni/ 'dod yon sogs lngas mnyes pa sogs bya/ zhes gsungs te/ phyi 'dod pa'i longs spyod lnga ni gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i mchod pa'i khyad par bzang zhing rgya che ba dang gzhan yang longs spyod dbul/

nang 'dod pa'i longs spyod ni/ bla ma dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgom pa yin/ de'i rten rig ma rgyan brgyan gyis brgyan pa dbul/ pho nya'i lam mi bsgom na thugs ji ltar mnyes par 'gyur ba'i mchod pa bya/ sogs kyi sgra nyes pa bshags pa dang / dbang blang ba la sogs pa bzung ngo / /gnyis pa bye brag gi dam tshig nyams pa bskang ba'i thabs ni/ mnyam gzhag gi dam tshig nyams na ye shes mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang ste/ lta ba tshad du skyang / rjes spyod kyi dam tshig nyams na ma mo mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang ste/ sgom pa tshad du rkyang / lhag ma dam tshig gzhan nyams na/ sha za mkha' 'gro dang dam tshig mkha' 'gro mnyes dgos te/ gtor ma rgya chen po dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo la sogs pas mnyes par bya/ bzhi pa lam gyi thun bzhi la dbang bzhi blang ba ni/ lam gyi thun bzhi la dbang bzhi bsgom pas/ zhes 'byung ba'i don la/ dbang rgyas bsdus gsum las/ dang po rgyas par blang ba'i tshul ni/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug lus kyi 'khor lo gsal btab pa'i rjes la rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis dbang bskur ba'i lha de bzhin gshegs pa/ rig ma lha mo/ byang chub sems dpa'/ khro bo ste gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha spyan drangs/ lha mo brgyad kyis mchod/ dbang bskur bar gsol ba btab/ de dag gi mdun du ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa/ dbu brgyan/ rdo rje dril bu ste/ dbang rdzas rnams pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs par bsam/ dbang bskur bar mdzad pa ni/ rgyu dus kyi bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rnam par sgom/ de nas he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa zhig spros nas/ dbang gi las mdzad par bsam/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rigs lnga so sor dam tshig pa bskyed/ skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug pa dang yan lag gsum 'dra bar bya/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan/

rig mas rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpas bkra shis brjod/ khro bos bgegs bskrad/ lha mos mchod par bsam/ de'ang dmigs pa gsal na phyi'i dkyil 'khor dang / lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyis blang / dmigs pa 'bring pos phyi'i he ru ka dang pho brang lnga'i gtso bos blang / gzhan rnams kyis thob par bsam/ dmigs pa rgya chung na he ru kas blangs la gzhan rnams kyis thob par bsam/ lhag ma mchod pa dang / bshad pa lnga/ thun mong gi brtul zhugs rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang dang / dbang gong ma gsum rgyu dus kyi dbang dang 'dra/ 'on kyang lung bstan ma rtogs pa'i mtha' rten gsum ma blangs kyang chog gsung / dkyil 'khor gang du dbang gang thob/ dri ma gang dag gsum yang dran par bya/ gnyis pa dbang 'bring du len na/ gsol ba gdab pa yan chad dbang rgyas pa bzhin byas la/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zung shig rdor rje byin gyis brlabs/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ /zhes bya bas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang thob par bsam/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ba/ /bdag gis gsang ba'i dbang gis ni/ /sems kyi rgyun gyi dbang bskur ro/ /zhes bya bas gsang dbang thob par bsam/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo 'di/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma/ /khyer gcig khyer gcig sems dpa' che/ /khyer la mchod pa rtag tu gyis/ /zhes bya bas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob par bsam/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing / /rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ /rdul phran mthar phyin zhi ba nyid/ /khyod kyi pha ni khyod nyid do/ /zhes bya bas dbang bzhi pa thob par bsam/ gsum pa dbang bsdus pa ni/ byang chub kyi sems kyi chu rgyun gcig gis smin mtshams yan chad gang / lus kyi dri ma dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ mgrin pa yan chad gang /

ngag gi dri ma dag gsang ba'i dbang thob/ snying kha cha yan chad gang / yid kyi dri ma dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ rkang mthil yan chad gang / dri ma dag pa brtan par byas/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan/ dbang bzhi pa thob par mos pa'o/ /'di ni slob dpon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug pad+ma badz+ra dang dgongs pa mtshungs par bzhed do/ /lus la brten nas bde chen gyi sgrib pa dgag cing 'tshang rgya bar gsal bas bshad rgyud ces bya ba ni/ rgyu dus kyi dbang yang lus la brten nas thob/ lam dus kyi dbang yang lus la brten nas len/ 'bras bu'i dbang yang lus la brten nas mthar phyin/ rten 'brel lus la sgrig spang bya lus la spong / gnyen po lus la rten pa lam lus la bgrod pas so/ /spyir pha rol tu phyin pa'i sems sbyangs pas lus rim gyis dag par 'dod pas dka' zhing yun ring / gsang sngags pa lus sbyangs pas sems shugs la dag par 'gyur bas bla zhing myur du 'grub pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin no/ /de'ang lus la zug rngu drag po yod pa la nga mi na snyam du bsgom pas phan par dka' zhing / lus la gtar spyad la sogs pa'i thabs kyis myur du phan pa bzhin no/ /zhes gsung / bde chen gyi sangs rgyas yin la/ de la sgrib pa ni/ nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa yin mod kyi/ skabs 'dir nyams skyon can brgyad nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa yin pas de la bag chags dang bcas pa 'gag cing skyon med las kyang / yul snang stong zung 'jug shes pa gsal stong zung 'jug lus bde stong zung 'jug gsum ni bde stong mchog gi ye shes su 'gyur ba'o/ /'tshang rgya bar gsal ba ni/ lus la rten 'brel 'grig pa nyid kyis sku dang ye shes zung 'jug gi rdo rje 'chang chen po 'grub pa la the tshom med de/ rgyu tshogs pa tshang ba las 'bras bu skye bar nges pa bzhin no/

/bshad rgyud ni rtogs par bya/ rgyu sems kun gzhi rtsa ba'i rgyu yin la/ de rtogs par byed pa lus la rten 'brel 'grig pas gtan la phebs pa'i phyir lus bshad rgyud du rnam par gzhag go /de ltar na chos bzhis lus thabs rgyud bshad zin to/ gsum pa 'bras bu ni/ phyag rgya chen po 'bras bu'i rgyud ni 'bras bu'i dbang bzhis thams cad mkhyen to/ /zhes bya ba'i don ni/ spyir phyag rgya chen po sgra mang po la 'jug ste/ brjod pa tshig gi phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba ni dho ha la sogs par brjod bral dang bsgom med la sogs pa 'chad pa lta bu yin/ bsgom pa dmigs pa'i phyag rgya chen po ni dran pa med pa dang / yid la bya ba med pa bsgom pa dang / lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa bsgom la yid rtse gcig tu 'jog pa ste/ rang sku lha'i sku phyag rgya chen por bsgom pa phyag rgya'i dam tshig tu gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /go ba nyams myong gi phyag rgya chen po ni yid la mi byed pa la sogs pa'i nyams myong cung zad skyes pa'o/ /mtshon pa dpe'i phyag rgya chen po ni/ dbang gsum pa la sogs pa'i ye shes kyi mtshon nas dpe'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pa'o/ /rtogs pa ye shes kyi phyag rgya chen po ni/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub snying po kyai rdo rje'i go 'phang thob ces bya ba rdo rje 'chang chen po grub pa'o/ /des na phyag rgya chen po'i dbye ba la mkhas dgos/ phyag rgya chen po ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i sde snod 'bum la sogs pa nas bshad pa med/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde las gsungs pa yin no/ /ding sang phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa phal cher yid la mi byed pa la phyag rgya chen por byed pa mthong ste/ de gsang sngags las bshad pa'i phyag rgya chen po mtshan nyid pa min/ des na rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i phyag rgya chen po nyams su blangs pas myur du 'tshang rgya'o/

/'bras bu'i rgyud ces bya ba ni/ lam gyis bsgrub pa'i yon tan mthar phyin pas 'bras bu rang don gyi ye shes dang / gzhan don gyi 'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad pas rgyud do/ /'bras bu'i dbang ni/ bum dbang rtsa'i 'gros/ gsang dbang yi ge'i 'gros/ shes rab ye shes kyis thig le'i 'gros/ dbang bzhi pa rlung gi 'gros/ de ltar na dbang bzhis 'gros bzhi thim pa'i rten 'brel lo/ /thams cad mkhyen to zhes bya ba ni/ sku thams cad mkhyen pa sprul sku/ gsung thams cad mkhyen pa longs sku/ thugs thams cad mkhyen pa chos sku/ sku gsung thugs thams cad mkhyen pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste/ rten gnas gyur gyi sku bzhi/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste/ sku lnga mngon du byed pa'o/ /de dag gis rgyud gsum du rtogs pa bshad zin to/ /gsum pa tshad ma bzhir bstan pa ni/ tshad ma bzhis 'bras bu gtan la phab nas ces bya ba'i don la/ tshad ma ni bden pa'i don la nges shes skyes nas gzhan gyi mos pa 'phrog par mi nus so/ /de la bzhi las/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' yang dag pa lung gi tshad ma ni/ sangs rgyas kyis nges don gyi/ mdo rgyud las ji ltar gsungs pa'o/ /dngos po'i mtha' rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba/ lo rgyus kyi tshad ma ni/ sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i rten 'brel phyin ci ma log pa thugs su chud pa'i gsung rdo rje tshig rkang la sogs pa'o/ /bla ma dam pa nyams kyi man ngag tshad ma ni/ lung dang lo rgyus phyin ci ma log pa thugs su chud cing / nyams su myong nas ma 'khrul bar ston pa'i bla ma'o/ /rnal 'byor pa rang nyid nyams myong rjes su dran pa'i tshad ma ni/ sngar gyi tshad ma gsum dang mi 'gal ba'i nyams myong khyad par can skyes pa'o/ /'bras bu gtan la dbab pa ces gsung yang / rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu thams cad gtan la 'bebs so/ /de la dang po rgyu gtan la 'bebs pa ni/

'khor ba'i rgyu nyon mongs pa dang / 'bras bu rigs drug gtan la dbab pa/ gnyis las/ nyon mongs pa gtan la dbab na/ sgom pa'i tshe chags sdang blo bur ba sna tshogs skye ba nyams myong / de nyid bla ma'i zhal nas sgom pa'i tshe nyon mongs pa sna tshogs rang byung du skye zhes gsung ba nyams kyi man ngag de nyid slob dpon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug gis rtsa 'dzin sogs su shing sdong sogs chags sdang rnam pa lnga dang / zhes gsungs pa lo rgyus de nyid brtag gnyis las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang phrag dog dang / /de bzhin gti mug nga rgyal nyid/ /ces bya ba la sogs pa lung tshad ma'o/ /gnyis pa rigs drug gtan la dbab na rang nyid la rigs drug so so'i nyams skyes/ bla mas kyang bsgom pa'i tshe skye gsung / 'di nyid las kyang rigs drug gi yi ger rlung sems mnyam par 'dus nas/ rigs drug gi gar sngags der khrid pa rmi lam nyams lta bu khams gsum kun tu snang ngo / /zhes 'byung / brtag gnyis las kyang / dmyal ba yi dwags byol song dang / /lha dang lha min mi rnams kyang / /zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs so/ /gsum pa 'bras bu gtan la dbab pa la gnyis las/ chos sku gtan la phab na/ bdag gi rgyud la chos sku'i nyams 'byung / bla mas kyang 'byung gsung / 'di nyid las kyang / yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sogs kyi pho brang du thim na/ chos sku nyams su myong zhing gzung 'dzin grol/ zhes 'byung / sam bu ṭi las kyang / rang 'byung ngo bo 'di nyid ni/ /chos kyi sku ni rab tu grags/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa gzugs sku la sbyar na/ bdag gi de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga mthong ba 'byung / bla mas kyang de ltar 'byung gsung / 'di nyid las kyang bdud rtsi lnga dang de bzhin gshegs sku sogs/ zhes 'byung / brtag gnyis las kyang / rnam snang mi bskyod don yod dang / /rin chen dpag med sems dpa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/

/bzhi pa thams cad gtan la dbab pa ni/ bdag gi rgyud la 'khor 'das kyi chos shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa'i snang ba 'char/ bla mas kyang / de ltar 'byung gsung / 'di nyis las kyang / srid pa'i rtse mo man chad ting nge 'dzin gyi nyams su 'byung ba snyam byed pa bshad kyis mi lang ba mtshon cing lnga bcu pa gsung / zhes 'byung / brtag gnyis las kyang / nga las 'gro ba thams cad 'byung / /nga las gnas gsum po yang 'byung / /nga yis 'di kun khyab pa ste/ /'gro ba'i rang bzhin gzhan ma mthong / /zhes gsungs so/ /'o na thams cad gtan la 'bebs dgos pa la/ 'bras bu gtan la bab ces gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin snyam na/ rgyu sems can dang / lam sgom pa la the tshom mi za'i/ 'bras bu 'tshang rgya ba la the tshom za bas/ gtso bor 'bras bu gtan la 'bebs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin/ dper na/ tshong pa tshong la zong la the tshom za ba'i zong gi khye 'byung ba la the tshom za bas de la nan tan byed pa bzhin no/ /bzhi pa gdam ngag drug tu bstan pa la gnyis/ thun mong gi gdam ngag drug dang / rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa'i gdam ngag drug go /dang po ni/ dug dbyung / bdud rtsi rten/ la dor/ zhen pa zlog rgyal ba blang / mthor ba bsdu ba'o/ /de rnams 'di'i skabs don ma yin pas 'dir mi gsung ngo / /thun mong ma yin pa'i gdam ngag drug ni/ bsam gtan nyi gnas gyi dug dbyung / bdud rtsi rten/ la dor/ lta lhag mthong ba'i dug dbyung / bdud rtsi rten/ la dor ba ste drug go /de'ang gzhung las/ bsam gtan gyi gsum sngon la 'byung yang / bshad pa la lta ba'i gsum sngon la gsung bas de brjod na gzhung 'khrugs su byas la/ 'jug pa sel ba'i lam yid 'dag pa'i rnam rtog bsgom pas lta ba'i dug dbyung / zhes gsungs pa'i don ni/ spyir lta ba la gnyis te/ thos pa'i shes pa lta bar 'dod pa dang /

nyams myong gi ting nge 'dzin la lta bar 'dod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i lta ba/ so so'i gzhung lugs la rang gi zhe 'dod zhugs pa'i lta ba/ tshul bzhin yid la byed pa'i lta ba/ de kho na nyid rgya mtsho'i don dang ma bral ba'i lta ba/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang na mnyam pa'i lta ba'o/ /de lta bu'i lta ba rtog tu zin kyang rnam rtog rgyun chags kyi dug sel mi nus shing mthong lam skye mi nus pa lta ba dug can zhes bya ste/ zas ro brgya pa dang 'dres nas bzar mi rung ba bzhin no/ /de la dug de 'byin pa ni/ 'jug pa sel ba'i lam yid 'dag pa'i rnam rtog bsgom pas zhes bya ste/ de'ang bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu sngon du song nas/ srog rtsol gyi sbyor ba lta bu gcig la rlung dang sems gcig tu 'dres te bsgoms pas rnam rtog gzhan gsal nas/ de nyid la rtse gcig tu gnas na 'jug pa sel ba'i lam zhes bya/ de nyid rtog pa dang byas pa'i yid sbyong ba'i gnyen po rnam rtog yin pas/ yid 'dag pa'i rnam rtog bsgom pas zhes gsungs te/ mdor na rnam rtog gi gnyen por rnam rtog gtong ba yin no/ /yid la byed pa mtha' dag gis stong na chags pa gcod pa'i lam zhes bya/ gzhan lha'i rnam pa'am du ba la sogs pa 'ga' zhig la gnas na byang chub chen po'i lam zhes bya bar dkral lo/ /de dag kyang rim pa yin min du skye bas drod byung rgyal du bskyang ngo / /des kyang lta ba'i dug ma phyin na/ shes pa yul 'dod pa yin pas yul gyi bdud rtsi brten par bya ste/ rnam shes lnga yul lnga ma spangs pas bdud rtsi rten/ zhes bya ste/ mig ngo mtshar gyi lta mo sna tshogs blta ba nas/ lus kyi reg bya'i bar sems gang la 'jug pa de lam bkag par longs spyod pas yul de nyid kyi steng du gnas te ting nge 'dzin skye'o/ /de'ang sngar mi gnas pa la rnam rtog sngon du song ba'i drod ces bya la/

sems gnas pa la yul sna tshogs kyi bdud rtsi ston pa zhes bya ba bogs 'byin pa brgyad las gcig tu 'gyur ro/ /'o na yul sna tshogs kyis bdud rtsi bsten pas ting nge 'dzin skye na sems can thams cad kyang yul brten pa yin pas ting nge 'dzin skye bar 'gyur ro/ /snyam na ma yin te/ dag pa'i chos rnams gdod nas stong par shar bas la dor/ zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni/ yul yul can thams cad gdod nas skye med stong pa rnam thar sgo gsum gyi rang bzhin yin pas don la bcings pa dang / grol ba gnyis ka med do/ /bcings pa dang grol bar snang ba ni kun rdzob tu thabs gang la mkhas pa dang / mi mkhas pa la rag las pas gnad mi shes na rnam rtog rgyud ma'am/ rnam rtog kun bu bsgom pa'i bdud ces bya ba tha mal gyi rnam rtog gi rgyur 'gyur ro/ /des na thabs mkhas pas yul thams cad skye med stong par la dor bas dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin du 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa nyams myong gi ting nge 'dzin la lta bar 'dod pa ni/ dug thon pa'i ting nge 'dzin phyin ci ma log pa rgyud la skyes pas mthong lam gyi ye shes skyed nus pa'i lam phyir lta ba dug med par rnam par gzhag go /gnyis pa bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung ba ni/ 'gal 'dus skyon med sogs gsum gyis bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung / zhes gsungs pa'i don ni/ lta ba'i dug thon yang bsam gtan gyi dug nyams skyon can brgyad byung na/ skyon med gsum gyis bton te/ de'ang bum dbang gi lta ba la snang phyogs stong phyogs sgro bkur kyis bsdus pa gnyis skye'i/ /zung 'jug skyer ma nyan/ gsang dbang la/ nyon mongs pa/ rnam rtog snrel gzhi ste bying rgod kyis bsdus pa gsum skye'i/ rang 'byung gi ye shes skyer ma nyan/ dbang gong ma gnyis la dga' ba/ mchog dga'/ dga' bral rnam rtog gis bsdus pa gsum skye'i/ lhan skyes dang / bde stong mchog skyer ma nyan na/

skyed pa'i thabs ni/ de dag nyid la gdam ngag gi gnad kyis zin par bya ste/ byung rgyal du shes par byas nas bsgoms pas skyon med gsum skye'o/ /de ltar 'bad kyang skyer ma nyan na/ 'gal 'dus skyon med gsum nyams su blang ste/ yul snang stong zung du chud par bya ba ni/ gnas khang dben par bsam gtan gyi yan lag sngon du song bas me long chen po mngon du bzhag ste/ rang ngam yi dam gyi lha'i bris sku rgyab du bkram la 'char du bcug nas spyir snang ba dang stong pa 'gal yang / me long gi gzugs brnyan la mi 'gal zhing skyon med par shes par bya ste/ de'ang yul thams cad bsres shing bsgoms pas zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin skye ste/ dug thon par 'gyur ro/ /rang byin brlabs kyi shes pa gsal stong zung du gzhug pa ni/ khang pa thog dpangs mtho ba nyi ma 'char ba'i sar bsam bstan gyi yan lag sngon du song nas/ bar snang gi nyi ma shar ba bltas pas/ spyir gsal ba dang stong pa 'gal yang bar snang gi nyi ma la mi 'gal zhing skyon med par shes par byas nas ste/ de nyid goms par byas pas snang ba sems kyi mtshan nyid/ stong pa sems kyi ngo bo/ bcos min sems kyi rang bzhin gyi gsal stong dbyer med kyi ye shes skye ste dug thon no/ /dbang gong ma gnyis kyis lus bde stong zung du gzhug pa ni/ steng du longs spyod kyi brlabs la brten te bde ba bsgom pa dang / 'og tu gsang ba'i snyoms 'jug la brten te bde ba bsgom pa'o/ /de ltar bsgom pas lus bde stong zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin bsgom ste dug thon par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar 'bad kyang nyams skyon can dang skyon med gang yang skyer ma nyan na/ ting nge 'dzin skye ba'i rgyu khams rgud pa yin pas bdud rtsi brten pa ni/ zas spyod lam rlung thig le phyag rgya brten/ zhes gsungs pa'i don sems mi gnas pa gnas par byed pa'i bdud rtsi/

gnas pa bogs 'byin pa'i bdud rtsi/ skyon sel ba'i bdud rtsi'o/ /dang po ni zas kyi spang bya dang / brten bya gnyis las/ spang bya ni/ chang tsha skyur/ sha rul spangs/ mi 'ju ba'i zas mtha' dag nya dang ri bong gi sha/ rtsong dang ri sgog la sogs pa rtsub pa'i zas mtha' dag dang / ha cang lan tshwa ches pa spang ngo / /brten bya ni/ bdud rtsi rgyun sbyor zhes bya ba ldum sgog cung zad rten par ro/ /a ru ra/ sha chen sum cu/ 'o ma bre gang du bcud skol te sbang / a ru ra gnyer ma snyoms/ 'o ma zho bzhin du chags te 'ju mi 'ju'i tshod dang sbyar la rten/ yang chu bre brgyad/ 'o ma bre bzhi/ mar bre do/ /spal me la bkrug cing btsos pas/ chu'i nus pa 'o ma la thim/ 'o ma'i nus pa mar la thim pa dang / de'i dngas ma g.ya' med pa'i snod du blugs te/ de la ka ra bu ram tsha ba gsum dang 'bras bu la sogs pa dang rang gi khams dang bstun la sbyar/ de 'ju tshod tsam bza'/ yang a ru ra sum cu/ ba ru ra nyi shu/ kyu ru ra cung zad zhib par btags te sbrang rtsis mgo bsdus te/ ril bu sran ma tsam byas la/ tshes gcig nas bcu gcig gi bar la gcig nas bcu gcig gi bar bza'/ de nas 'ju tshod khams dang bstun pa bza'o/ /yang sha chen rul pungs med pa/ rdo bsregs pa'i bar du mnan la chu ser gdon/ de zhib par btags te/ rgyus pa la sogs pa bsal nas tsha ba gsum la sogs pa rang gi khams dang bstun nas sbyar la/ lto stong la byi la'i rkang rjes tsam zhes pa sor mo gsum gyis blangs pa'i tshad tsam bza'/ yang dri chen nyin gcig la skams te ra ro gdon nas legs par brdungs te ra ro gdon/ de sbrang rtsis mgo bsus la ril bu byas te/ snga ma bzhin du rten no/ /yang dbang po lag pa zhib par byas te/ ra dkar mo'am ba/ zal chags la sogs pa'i 'o mar skol la/ ril bu'am dras shing 'ju tshod bza'/ de dag gis lo gcig nas rtsa mi mngon pa'i bcud len du 'gyur zhing ting nge 'dzin mchog skye ba'i grogs su 'gyur ro/

/spyod lam gyi spang bya ni/ me dang / nyi ma dang / ngal dub la sogs pa rngul 'byung ba'i spyod pa rnams spang ngo / /rten bya ni tsog pu'am skyil krung la goms par bya ba dang / kha zas dang spyod lam bag yangs so/ /rlung ni sngar gyi sbyor ba bdun las gang rung 'jug go /thig le ni sngar gyi rnal 'byor bzhi las gang rung gcig go /phyag rgya ni pho nya'i lam bsgom na dngos/ rnal 'byor gyi lam bsgom na ye shes kyi phyag rgya brten pa'o/ /gnyis pa gnas pa bogs 'byin pa'i bdud rtsi ni/ da pa ma lnga'i bde ba dang zhes gsungs pa'i don bde ba gang du skyes pa'i gnas der shes pa gtad la/ rtsol ba bkag ste srog nas btang zhing mig steng du lta ba'i 'gyur ba la goms par byas pas/ lus thams cad la khyab par byas par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa skyon sel ba'i bdud rtsi ni/ dbang po lnga nyams dang ma bral ba'i bdud rtsi rten/ zhes gsungs te/ mig dang rna ba la sogs pa mi gsal ba dang / zug zer la sogs pa byung na/ de bsal bar bya ba dang / gzhan yang ting nge 'dzin gegs dang / lus la bde ba dang zug zer la sogs pa 'dres nas byung na/ gang du bde ba dang zug zer skyes pa der shes pa gtad la/ ngag 'dren pa zhi drag gis gang byung bar drangs pas skyon thams cad las grol zhing bde ba skye'o/ /gsum pa la dor ba ni/ de ltar bdud rtsi brten pas ting nge 'dzin skye ste/ rtsa rlung gi zug byung na la dor ba byas te/ de la gsum/ rtsa de nyid kyi gnas su la dor/ rlung rngan dgas byin te la dor/ sems nyams kyi drod byung rgyal du la dor ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/ 'khor ba'i rtsa la dor ba ni/ 'khor ba'i rtsa bzhi dang / 'khor lo rnams dang / gzhan rnams dang / zhes gsungs te/ de'ang 'khor ba'i rtsa bzhi ni/ rtsa gsum po lte ba yan chad po 'khor ba'i rtsa bzhir 'gyur te/ g.yas nas rak+ta 'phen cing 'dzin par byed/ g.yon nas byang chub kyi sems/

mdun nas dri chu/ rgyab nas dri chen 'phen cing 'dzin par byed pa'o/ /'khor lo rnams ni smin mtshams dang gsang gnas na byang chub kyi sems dang rak+ta 'dzin pa mi g.yo ba'i 'khor lo gnyis/ g.yo ba'i 'khor lte snying mgrin pa spyi bo'i 'khor lo lo bzhi/ las byed pa'i 'khor lo gnyis/ ni 'og rlung gi 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa/ sum mdor me'i 'khor lo rtsibs gsum pa'o/ tshigs chen bcu gnyis lag mgo'i tshigs gnyis/ gru mo gnyis/ dpung mgo gnyis/ bom gong gnyis/ lus spyi gnyis so/ ni nad 'du ba bzhi bskyed pa'i 'khor lo 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis pa bcu gnyis la sogs pa'o/ /gzhan rnams ni spyir rigs drug ste/ gru gu dril pa ste bu'i rtsa 'khor gtsor snying kha na sbrul bcus pa lta bu'i rtsa 'khor mgrin pa na skra shad 'dzings pa lta bu'i rtsa 'khor tshigs chen na gnas/ rtsa 'di gsum gtso che ba'i gang zag de la bsgom skye dka'/ gegs mang zhing sel dka'/ de la lus kyi 'khrul 'khor gyis rtsa bshig nas bsgoms pas ting nge 'dzin skye zhing gegs sel/ thags rgyangs pa lta bu'i rtsa 'khor lte ba na/ ljon shing gyes pa lta bu'i rtsa 'khor/ yan lag la gdugs phub pa lta bu'i rtsa 'khor/ spyi bo na gnas 'di gsum gtso che ba'i gang zag de la ting nge 'dzin skye bla/ gegs nyung / byung yang sel sla'o/ /de rnams su gegs byung sar/ rig pa sems kyi tshir non byas la bzung nas la dor bas grol bar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i rtsa la dor ba ni/ sa thog mtha' la re re/ gsum pa bcus bar gyi rtsa mdud bral bas la dor/ zhes gsungs te/ rtsa dbu mar rlung 'du gcig la ro rkyang gnyis kyis bcer ba dog pa'i gnas mdud pa sum cu rtsa gnyis yod pa las/ sa dang po dang chu gnyis pa la mdud pa re re grol bar du bcu la/ sbyor ba mgo rtsom/ dngos gzhi longs spyod/

'jug pa ste mdud pa gsum gsum la dor bas re re 'grub bo/ /de ltar la dor bas sangs rgyas kyi sar rtsa mi mngon pa dang / mdud pa med pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin no/ /rlung rngan dgas sbyin pa la sogs pa gnyis 'og tu 'chad do/ /lnga pa snyan rgyud bzhir bstan pa ni/ gsang sngags snyan brgyud spel ma 'chad pa'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ snyan brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang nas bdag gi bar du tshig gi brgyud pa bar ma chad pa'o/ /sogs bzhi ni/ don gyi brgyud pa bzhi ma chad pa ste/ dbang gi chu bo ma nub/ gdam ngag gi sarka ma log byin brlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams/ mos gus kyi bsam pa tshim pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyu dus su bla ma las dbang phyin ci ma log pa thob/ lam dus kyi dbang gis chu bo ni rang gi thun bzhir bsgoms pas 'bras bu'i dus kyi dbang ni/ rgyal ba sku bzhi las dbang bzhi thob pa ste/ 'gros bzhi thim pa'o/ /gdam ngag gi sarka ma log pa ni/ dbang bzhi thob pas de'i lam bzhi sangs rgyas kyi gsung bzhin ma nor zhing sarka ma log par shes pa yin la/ de'ang ting nge 'dzin ngo shes pas bsam gtan gyi gegs sel/ bar chad ngo shes pas bdud kyi gegs sel/ skyon yon tan du blongs zhing / bar chad dngos grub tu len pa'i gdam ngag sngar bshad pa bzhin phyin ci ma log par khong du chud pa'o/ /byin brlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa ni/ gsang sngags mtha' bzhi'i bdud rtsi yin te/ rtsa rlung dang 'khrul 'khor la sogs pa'i gnad yang dag par nyams su blangs pas mtha' lus nyams sems nyams la sogs pa nyams su myong ba'i mtha'/ nang rten 'brel 'grig pa bla ma dang yi dam gyi lha yogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad pad+ma'i mtsho la ngang pa ltar bdag gi rgyud byin brlabs 'jug pa byin brlabs kyi mtha' de nas sa dang po yan chad 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sems thob pa grub pa'i mtha'o/

/mos gus kyi bsam pa tshim pa ni/ rgyu dus su/ bla ma'i gsung phyin ci ma log pa rtogs pas bar chad dang dngos grub thams cad rang gi lus la rtsa rlung gi rten 'brel las byung ba'i mos pa khyad par can skyes te/ bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes skye/ 'di bas lhag pa'i gdam ngag gzhan na med par sgro 'dogs chod pa'o/ /drug pa rten 'brel sngar bstan pa ni bdun las/ dang po rten 'brel 'grig pa'i gzhi ni/ lus khyad par can la brten nas zhes gsungs te/ de'ang lus khyad par can ni/ rtsa dang yi ge rkyen yin gyi skyon can gyis tshe 'di la 'tshang rgya ba'i rten 'brel sgrig mi nus pa'o/ /gnyis pa rten 'brel gyi mtha' gang yin pa ni/ dngos po'i mtha' rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba ste/ dngos med la rten 'brel sgrig mi nus pas dngos po'i de'i mthar thug pa ni/ lam rim pa gnyis dang / des sgrub pa'i 'bras bu mthar thug pa'o/ /gsum pa rang bzhin gsum las gang yin na/ gzhan dbang rten 'brel te/ kun brtags ni ngo bo ma grub/ yongs grub ni gzhan dbang las de nyid dang gzhan du brjod du med pa'i phyir/ rnam par rtog pa gzhan gyis dbang nyid la rten 'brel sgrigs pas thams cad la khyab ste/ shing gi rtsa bar chu blugs pas yal ga lo 'dab thams cad la khyab pa bzhin no/ /bzhi pa lam bzhi las gang yin na/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam/ zhes gsungs te/ nyan thos kyi/ rten 'brel gyis dgra bcom pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi rten 'brel gyis rang rgyal/ byang chub sems dpa'i rten 'brel gyis bskal pa grangs med gsum na 'tshang rgya/ 'di'i tshe 'di la 'tshang rgya bas byang chub chen po'i rten 'brel sgrig go /lnga pa tshad ma bzhi las gang yin na/ chos thams cad rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i lo rgyus kyi tshad ma'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ chos thams cad rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba las ma 'das pa/ mdo rgyud kyi dgongs pa yin la/

de lam du byed pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po'i lam 'bras 'dis phyin ci ma log par ston pas na lo rgyus kyi tshad ma'o/ /drug pa rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba 'dis mtshon cing rtogs pa'i don gang yin na/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes dag pa'i byang chub chen po/ zhes gsungs te/ chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba sems/ de'i rtsa ba kun gzhi 'dir ngos shog chad pa dgongs 'jag 'tshal/ te/ nye du dang 'brel ba'i bar chad la zang zing gi sbyin pa sngon du 'gro ba'i dad pa brtan pos bsrung / bla ma grogs mched kyi bar chad la zang zing gi sbyin pa dang rtse sems sngon du 'gro ba'i dad pa brtan pos bsrung ngo / /phyi rol bdud kyi bar chad la/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo/ sngags bzlos sngags mdud gsum ces gsum pas/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bri zhing bsgoms pa dang / bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa la sogs pa sngags bzlos/ phyi nang gi sngags mdud kyis bdud kyi bar chad bsrung ba ste bzhi gzhan la zhu ba dang / thabs kyi bar chad thabs kyis bsrung ba bzhi'o/ /'ga' zhig mi dang dud 'gro ma rtogs pa 'gro ba gzhan kun kha 'phangs pa yin zer skad lha 'dre med par re dogs dang bral zhes zer ba dang kha gcig bdud rtsi bas dug mi bzang sman mi lhag sman rten na skyabs 'gro la gnod pas sman mi rten zhes zer ba dang / khro bo bsgoms pas byang chub kyi sems la gnod ces zer ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung dang mi mthun te/ mdo rgyud rnams las bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dang de'i gnod pa bzlog pa'i sngags dang ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa dpag tu med pa gsungs pa'i phyir dang / sman zos pa skyabs 'gro la gnod na/ bza' btung zos pas kyang skyabs 'gro la gnod par 'gyur te/ sman rnam bzhi'i gcig yin pa'i phyir dang / 'dul ba lung las dge slong nad pas sman brten par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / mdo rgyud rnams las sman dpyad kyi thabs dpag tu med pa gsungs pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/

/khro bo sgom pas byang chub kyi sems la gnod na/ phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa la byang chub kyi sems med par 'gyur pa dang / gdug cing gtum pa'i sems can la'o/ /zhi ba nye bar mi sbyar te/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don ma go bar zad do/ /ting nge 'dzin 'dir ngos shog chad par dgongs 'jag 'tshal/ pa'i don la/ shes rab kyi phyogs su lhung ba'i gang zag la gnyis te/ mos pa'am 'jug pas shes rab kyi phyogs su lhung ba dang / nyams myong ting nge 'dzin gyis shes rab kyi phyogs su lhung ba'o/ /de gnyis ka la bar chad bzhi 'byung ste/ nyams la du kha bskyed pa/ gzugs ston pa/ sgra brjod pa/ lta sgrub bsgyur ba'i bar chad do/ /de bsrung ba ni 'og tu sbyar la/ shes rab kyi phyogs su lhung ba'i lam la/ lha'i bu'i bdud 'ong bas sad pa bzhis bsrung zhes gsungs pa'i don bshad na/ de la sad pa bzhi las de nyams kyi sad pa ni/ lus la na tsha dang / sems la du kha thun mgo la nges pa can du 'byung na bdud yin par shes par nyid kyis grol lo/ /thun rjes la byung na khams rgud pa yin pas khams so/ /nges med du byung na ting nge 'dzin gyi bye brag yin pas byung rgyal du btang / gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin gyis sad pa ni/ bdag gis dges pa rdo rje la sogs pa gang bsgom pa de 'dra ba gcig snang na/ bdag gis bde mchog lta bu bsgoms pas 'gyur na bdud/ mi 'gyur na mthong snang / chos dang mthun par lung ston na sangs rgyas nyid do/ /gsum pa sngags kyis sad pa ni/ dges pa'i rdo rje lta bu'i sngags rna bar drag na/ bdag gis bde mchog gi sngags bzlas pas lad mo byed na bdud/ mi byed na mthong snang / gsang mtshan nas lung ston na sangs rgyas yin a dngos grub blang / bzhi pa lta grub kyis sad pa ni/ dbang bzhi'i lta ba bzhi dang / grub mtha' bzhis yid kyis bris pas ma shes na bdud/ rgyu mtshan med par lta/ grub nor ces cal col du 'gro grag na thos snang /

shes nas lung ston na sangs rgyas yin par shes par bya'o/ /des na/ rnam gsum rigs dbye shin tu gces/ ces bya/ mthong snang 'dir ngos shog chad pa dgongs 'jag 'tshal/ bshad na/ grib ma'i rnam grangs/ che 'bring / rtags/ nyes pa mi 'byung ba'i thabs/ byung na sel ba'i cho ga'o/ /de la dang po rnam grangs ni/ grib ma chen po dam tshig grib/ /ces bya ba bla ma'i thugs dkrugs pa dang / ma gus pa'i rten 'brel las 'byung / gdon gyi grib ma ni gdon mi srun pa dang 'gras pa las 'byung / grogs kyi grib ni grogs dam tshig dang 'gal ba dang 'grogs pa las 'byung / zas kyi grib ni mi gtsang ba'i lag gi sbyar ba dang / dngos po mi gtsang ba las 'byung / gnas kyi grib ni srog chags mang po gsad pa dang / sdig pa can gyis yun ring po bsdad pa'i gnas las 'byung / ro'i grib ni dam tshig dang sdom pa nyams pa dang / gdon chen pos bzung ba la sogs pa'i ro'i bya ba byas pa las 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa che 'bring bstan pa ni/ dang por smos pa chen po/ bar gyi bzhi 'bring / tha ma'i gcig chung ngu'o/ /gsum pa grib ma'i rtags ni/ dam tshig gi grib ma ni/ dngos su lus sems mi bde/ yid mi gsal/ dge ba'i bya ba la blo mi 'jug pa la sogs pa dang / rmi lam du'ang bla ma mi dges pa dang / bka' skyon la sogs pa 'byung / gdon gyi grib ma la/ gdon dngos su bar chad rtsam pa dang / grib gnon dang / rmi lam du thog dang ser ba 'bab pa la sogs pa 'byung / grogs kyi grib ma la/ de dang 'phrad tsam na dngos su khams mi bde ba dang / rmi lam du mi gtsang sgod pa dang / 'bu srin dang shig la sogs pa 'jigs shing skyug bro ba bdag gi lus la 'thor ba la sogs pa 'byung / zas kyi grib ma la dngos su zas zos pa tsam gyis khams ldog pa tsam dang / rmi lam du zas la mi gtsang ba dres pa la sogs pa 'byung / gnas kyi grib ma 'dir ngos shog chad pa dgongs 'jag 'tshal/

'jug blang ngo / /tshogs kyi 'khor lo ni/ bla mas gtso mdzad pa'am/ yang na grogs tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa la'ang / sbyor dngos rjes gsum dang ldan pa'i cho ga phyin ci ma log pa'i mchod pa bya/ sbyin sreg gi las bzhi'i cho ga gnas dang mthun/ khyad par du grib ma'i nyes pa sel ba/ za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg ni/ rdza gsar pa'i ga'ur sol ba la bud shing gtsang ma la me sbar/ bdag nyid yi dam gyi lhar dmigs/ me bsangs sbyangs pa'i steng du dgra bgegs kyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje mkha' 'gro sku mdog sngon po shing du khros shing zhal gdangs pa/ phyag gnyis mthe'u chung lu rgyud 'dzum mo gnyis sdigs mdzub rkyang ba dang bcas pas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/ rus pa dang rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan par bskyed/ skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ ye shes 'khor lo dgug gzhug bya/ /dbang bskur rigs kyi bdag po mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bsam/ de nas rang gi snying gar sdig pa thams cad bsdu/ yi ge kaṃ gi rnam pa kha dog nag po sna sgo nas thon/ srog chags sdig pa zhes bya ba mi'i gzugs rid pa'am sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam pa til la thim/ de mtheb srin gyis bzung ba rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i zhal du dbul zhing / oṃ badz+ra ḍa ka kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba pa paṃ dha ha na bha smi ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes brjod do/ /ci nus byas pas sdig pa 'dag pa'i rtags myur du 'byung / mthar yi ge brgya pa brjod la gshegs su gsol/ khrus kyi sel ba ni/ bum pa dbang gi chu bo ltar bsham/ de'i nang du yi dam gyi lha yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ de'i sngags kyis bzlas pa rang ngam grogs tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pas zhag bdun gyi bar du bsnyen ba bya/ gdon gyi grib ma sel ba la drag po'i sbyin sreg gi thal ba/ btsan dug yungs dkar/ mi rus kyi phye ma rnams sbyar/

grib ma chung ngu la zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi thal ba dang sbyar nas yams nad gcod pa la dbang gi sbyin sreg gi thal ba dang sbyar la/ khrus kyi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas khrus bya zhing gtor/ grib ma sāts+tshas sel ba ni/ sa gtsang ma la cho ga ji lta ba bzhin du sāts+tsha brgya rtsa brgyad btab pa grogs dang bcas pas rab gnas byas la mchod pa bya/ rdo rje spun grogs rnams phan tshun la maṇ+ḍal phul/ rang rang gi dam tshig gi nyes pa bshags su gzhug de rnams la bdag gis maṇ+ḍal phul la/ bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa che ge mo zhes bya bas dam tshig gi nyes pa dang / grib ma'i nyes pa ci mchis pa thams cad so sor bshags pas dag par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod cing / sāts+tsha snod gtsang mar bzhag cing spyi bos blang / de dag gis kyang sāts+tsha bdag gi spyi bor bzhag la/ che ge mo'i grib ma dang dam tshig nyes pa thams cad dag par gyur gcig ces brjod do/ /dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur bya/ sāts+tsha'i phyed rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu gral du bzhag pa de'i rdul phra rab kyis khyab pa'i sems can rnams ngan song las thar pa yin gsung / phyed gnas dben par bzhag pa la mchod do/ /yi ge brgya pas gsal ba ni/ sngar bshad pa bzhin shes par bya'o/ /ngag gi man ngag kyis gsal ba ni/ bla ma'am rdo rje spun la maṇ+ḍal phul te/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa'am rigs kyi bu dgongs su gsol/ bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i stobs las bye brag tu sdom pa gsum dang 'gal bar byas pa rnams phyin chad ltung ba dang nyes pa'i tshogs ci mchis pa de thams cad/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan sngar mthol zhing bshags so/ /mthol zhing bshags na bdag bde ba la reg par gnas par 'gyur gyi/ ma mthol ma bshags na de ltar na mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/

yul gyis nyes pa la nyes par mthong ngam/ zhes dri/ bdag gis mthong zhes brjod/ de phyin chad sdom mam zhes dri/ bdag gis sdom zhes brjod/ yul gyis thabs yin no/ /bdag gis legs so zhes brjod do/ /'di mdo rgyud thams cad kyi dgongs pa thun mong ba yin no/ /gnyis pa khams 'dus pa bar pa la 'dzag pa bar chad du che bas/ de bsrung ba ni/ thig le 'dzag pa bsrung zhes bya ba'i don la drug las/ dang po bde ba skyes te gang bas 'dzag pa ni/ bde ba'i ting nge 'dzin skyes pa'i mthus/ thig le rgyas te rdzing gang ba 'dzag pa dang 'dra bas de bsrung ba ni/ rlung kha sbyar dang ngag 'dren pa zhi drag gi stobs kyis hūm̐/ 'gyur ba drug la sogs pa'i gnad shes pas bsrung ngo / /gnyis pa gdon gyis 'dzag pa la/ gu gul btsan dug mi'i klad pa pad ma'i rak+ta/ yungs kar bsregs pa'i thal ba rnams glang nga'i nang du tsha 'ur gyis sro/ de yi dam gyi lha'i gsang sngags bzlas pa'i chur sbyar te/ srod kyi dus su lte ba man chad kyi sked pa la byugs bas yi dam gyi lha'i gsang sngags bzlas pas bsrung / yang srad bu nag po la rdo rje'i mdud pa nyer gcig byas te/ grogs byin brlabs can 'ga' zhig gis zhag bdun tsam bsnyen pa byed du bcug la/ de rked par bcings pas bsrung / yang dpa' bo g.yul du bsad pa'i rus pa chu la gdar te/ lte ba'i 'og tu me long tsam gcig byug pa'o/ /gsum pa bag chags kyis 'dzag pa la/ khra ma gsar gyi sgo nga'am/ ngang pa ma gsar gyi sgong nga za ma tog gi nang du bcug ste lus la bcang / yang bud med kyi gos dri ma can yang lus la bcang / gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud dang / thun mong gi bsrung ba ni/ legs par grub pa las/ gzhon nus bskal ba'i skud pa ni/ /leb rgan rtsi'am gur gum du/ /btsos te mdud pa gsum byas la/ /srod la rig sngags stong rtsa brgyad/ /bzlas te rked par bcings byas nas/

/'dis ni bsgrub pa po rnams kyis/ /khu ba rtag tu 'dzin par 'gyur/ /oṃ shu kra dha ra dha ra bhan dha mi sid dha ar+the swāhā/ yang go zlog pa'i sbyor ba bzhes bya ba ni/ rang lha rgyal ba dam pa gcer bu skra thams cad gtogs pa/ lag pa g.yas pas rma bya'i mjug sgro'i phon pos gsang gnas bkag pa/ g.yon pas na ri ke la'i shing thog gi nang ba lang gi gci ba'i thal bas bkang la bzung zhing lus la'ang byugs la/ rkang pa g.yon skyil mo krung du byas pa'i steng du g.yas pa bzhag par bsgoms la/ sngags oṃ a ri han ta ts+tshug ts+tshug ces bzlas so/ /bzhi pa nad gzhi'i 'dzag pa la/ spyir zas yangs la bcud che ba brten/ lho stong la tsha ba gsum gyi gam phye bcud btang na/ gcan zan la sogs pa drod che ba'i lpags pa bcing / langs te gru mor sleb pa'i sor mo lnga'am bdun gdab/ yang sngo ma btang phyin bu zhes kyang zer/ me tog 'bras bu 'jar byed ces kyang bya ba de grib skams byas la zhig par brdungs te/ 'o ma bskol la ka ra cung zad dang sbyar te lto stong la btang ngo / /lnga pa rig ma'i rkyen gyis 'dzag pa ni/ 'gyur ba drug la sogs pa gong du bshad pa nyid kyis bsrung ngo / /drug pa spyod lam gyis bsrung ba ni/ sngar zas dang spyod lam gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar shes par byas la bsrung ngo / /gsum pa khams gsum 'dus pa tha ma la sgrib pa bar chad du che bas de bsrung ba ni/ gong gi sgrib pa zhes bya ba de 'dir blang la bshad na/ sgrib pa ni/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang / shes bya'i sgrib pa gnyis so/ /'di mthar thug ni mthong lam yan chad pas spong la/ gnas skabs su nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa ni rnam rtog rgyun chags te/ de ni 'jug pa sel ba'i lam la sogs pa gsum gyis bsrung / shes bya'i sgrib par 'dod pa'i nyams skyon can brgyad ni byung rgyal gyi gnad kyis skyon med gsum gyis bsrung ngo /

/de dag bskyed pa'i thabs gong du bstan zin to/ /de ltar chos bdun gyis 'khor 'das thun mong gi lam legs par bstan zin to/ /gnyis pa 'khor lo 'cham pa 'jig rten pa'i lam la chos bdun du gnas kyang / thog mar spyi'i rnam gzhag la/ bgrod lugs gnyis dang / 'khrid lugs gsum las/ dang po ni/ lam lnga ltar bgrod pa dang / byang chub kyi phyogs sum cu rtsa bdun ltar bgrod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ phyi dbyibs kyi tshogs lam la sogs pa bzhi/ sbyor lam rnam rtog sngon du song ba la sogs pa'i drod gsum/ phyi dang nang gi rtse mo gnyis ma sngar ma skyes pa'i chos pa bzod pa dka' ba stong pa nyid kyis bzod pa gcig mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam chos rnams rdzogs pa'i chos mchog ste/ ngo bo gcig la ldog pa gnyis/ de ltar lam tshogs sbyor gnyis kyis 'jig rten pa'i lam chod/ rtags gsum phrag dang pos mthong lam/ rtags gsum phrag bcu gcig gis bsgom lam/ 'gros bzhi thim pas mthar phyin gyi lam mo/ /gnyis pa byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun ltar lam bgrod na/ dang po snang ba dgrar langs kyi gnyen por rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi/ stong pa dgrar langs kyi gnyen por dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi/ bde ba dgrar langs kyi gnyen por yang dag par spong ba bzhi ste/ de ltar byang chub kyi phyogs bcu gnyis kyis 'jig rten pa'i lam chod/ de nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam la/ bum dbang la drug byang chub kyi yan lag bdun/ gsang dbang gi sa bzhi dbang po lnga/ shes rab ye shes kyi sa gnyis stobs lnga/ dbang bzhi pa'i sa phyed 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad do/ /gnyis pa 'khrid lugs gsum ni/ rlung gis lam khrid/ khams bdud rtsis lam khrid/ rtsa dang yi ges lam khrid pa'o/ /dang po ni/ khams 'dus pa dang po la gnod pa skyel ba'i rlung gis lam khrid/ bar pa la phan gnod med pa'i rlung gis lam khrid te/

'jig rten pa'i lam chod/ de nas 'jig rten la 'das pa'i lam la/ bum dbang sa drug la zag pa med pa'i rlung gis lam khrid/ gsang dbang sa bzhi la dbang po lnga'i rlung gis lam khrid/ shes rab ye shes sa gnyis la stobs lnga'i rlung gis lam khrid/ dbang bzhi pa'i sa phyed la srog dang rtsol ba rab tu thim pa'i rlung gis lam khrid de/ ye shes kyi rlung du gnas 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa khams 'dus pa dang por khams dwangs snyigs ma bye bar lam khrid/ bar pa la cung zad dwangs pas lam khrid/ tha ma la phal cher dwangs mas lam khrid/ des 'jig rten pa'i lam chod/ de nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam la/ bum dbang sa drug la khams dwangs mas lam khrid/ gsang dbang sa bzhi pa bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis lam khrid/ shes rab ye shes sa gnyis la khams dwangs ma chen pos lam khrid/ dbang bzhi pa'i sa phyed la dwangs ma'i dwangs ma chen pos lam khrid nas bdud rtsi'i 'gros thim ste/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gnas 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa rtsa dang yi ges lam khrid na khams 'dus pa dang po la ma nges pa 'khrul snang du 'char bas lam khrid/ bar pa la cung zad nges pa mthong snang du 'char bas lam khrid/ tha ma la shin tu nges pa gsal snang du 'char bas lam khrid/ des 'jig rten pa'i lam chod/ de nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam la/ bum dbang sa drug la yi ge stobs bcu dag pas lam khrid/ gsang dbang sa bzhi la yi ge'i stobs phal cher dag pas lam khrid/ shes rab ye shes sa gnyis la yi ge'i stobs dag pas lam khrid/ dbang bzhi pa sa phyed la yi ge'i stobs dag pa'i dag pas lam khrid de/ yi ge'i 'gros thim nas mi shigs pa'i yi ger 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa gzhung gi don la chos bdun ste/ ting nge 'dzin skye ba'i rgyu mdor bstan/ mdor bsdus te rgyas par bstan/ re dogs dang bral ba'i lam bstan/ sad pa bzhir bstan/ dran pa nyer bzhag rgyur bstan/ yang dag par spong ba'i 'bras bur bstan/

ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyis mjug bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ tshogs lam nas zhes gsungs te/ de'ang dbang bzhi'i rten 'brel gyis tshogs lam bzhi ste/ phyi dbyibs kyi tshogs lam ni/ tshogs zhing spyan drangs pa nas tshogs lam/ nang sngags kyi tshogs lam ni/ rtsa dbu ma'i ma rtser rlung sems 'dus pas nas tshogs lam/ gsang ba dbang bzhi'i tshogs lam ni/ shes rab kyi mkhar rlung sems tshogs pa gnas tshogs lam/ mthar thug de kho na nyid kyi tshogs lam ni/ dges sogs pad can bcu gnyis ma'i mchog gi ze bar rlung sems tshogs pa nas tshogs lam ste/ mdor na rten 'brel gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyu tshogs lam du bzhed do/ /tshogs lam nas 'bras bu bzhi 'byung ste/ tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid dang bral ba'i 'bras bu bzhi thob nas/ zhes gsungs te/ spyir gnas skabs gsum du 'bras bu bzhi 'jug ste/ rgyu dus su 'char ba'i 'bras bu bzhi/ grub mtha' dang po la 'char ba'i 'bras bu bzhi/ grub mtha' so so la 'char ba'i 'bras bu bzhi'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid dang bral ba'i 'bras bu kun bzhi la yod pa rang la smin pas rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu/ ji ltar byas pa bzhin nyams su myong bas rgyu mthun lhan cig skyes pa'i 'bras bu/ skyes bu rtsol ba las byung ba'am/ spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs spong bas skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu'am dri ma med pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /de la dang po ni tha mal pa'i lus dang bral bas lus lhar 'char/ ngag dang bral bas ngag sngags su 'char/ yid rnam par rtog pa dang bral bas mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin du 'char te 'bras bu dang po'o/ /yang kun gzhi la rigs drug gi skad kyis bag chags yod pas de smin nas ma bslab par skad tha dad shes pa dang / dngos po gang la yang chags thogs med pa snyam byed/ byas pa 'byung ste 'bras bu gnyis pa'o/ /yang lus la bde ba rgyun mi 'chad rngul gyi rkyen gyis kyang bde ba 'byung ste 'bras bu gsum pa'o/

/yang nyon mongs pa blo bur ba ldog chos brgyad kyi rnam par rtogs pa 'gag des mthong spangs kyi sgrib pa spong nus pas 'bras bu bzhi pa'o/ /gnyis pa grub mtha' dang po la/ 'char ba'i 'bras bu bzhi ni/ tha mal pa'i lus dang bral bas sprul sku mi 'dra ba brgya gzhan la ston nus/ ngag dang bral bas mdo sde la sogs pa gsung rab mi 'dra ba brgya 'chad nus/ yid dang bral bas dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin mi 'dra ba brgya la snyom par 'jug nus te 'bras bu dang po'o/ /yang gdul bya so so'i brda dang skad du chos ston pa la thogs pa med/ chu bo gyen la ldog nyi zla steng par 'dzin/ gcig la mang por byed/ mang po gcig tu byed pa la sogs pa la mnga' 'byor pas 'bras bu gnyis pa'o/ /yang rlung sems dbu mar chud/ bzung 'dzin las grol/ zag med kyi bde ba rgyun mi 'chad pas 'bras bu gsum pa'o/ /yang spang bya stobs chung / gnyen po stobs che/ sgom spang gi sgrib pa spong nus pas 'bras bu bzhi pa'o/ /gsum pa grub mtha' so so la 'char ba'i 'bras bu bzhi ni/ bum dbang sa drug la bral ba'i 'bras bu gtso che/ gsang dbang sa bzhi la rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu gtso che/ shes rab ye shes sa gnyis la rgyu mthun lhan cig skyes pa'i 'bras bu gtso che/ dbang bzhi pa'i sa phyed la skyes bu byed pa'am dri ma med pa'i 'bras bu gtso che'o/ /da ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyud dang ting nge 'dzin ni nyid dang de'i phan yon thams cad mdor bsdus te bstan pa'i phyir/ khams 'du lugs gsum gyi phyogs mdo rnams dang / zhes gsungs pas/ de la khams 'du lugs gsum ni/ las 'phro can rang gi ngang gis khams 'du/ mos gus can byin brlabs kyi khams 'du/ brtson 'grus can 'bad rtsol gyis khams 'du'o/ /phyogs med rnams dang / zhes bya ba'i don ni/ char drag po phyogs kun nas ldang ba ltar/

ting nge 'dzin phyogs ris med par skye bas phyogs med do/ /de'ang phyogs bdun dang dang po la sbyar na/ las 'phro phyogs med du sad pas rlung phyogs med du log gtum mo'i me phyogs med du 'bar/ rtsa phyogs med du bral/ khams phyogs med du 'du/ zag bcas kyi mngon shes phyogs med du 'char/ des zag med kyi mngon shes phyogs med du 'char/ de bzhin du mos gus phyogs med dang / brtson 'grus phyogs med gnyis la'ang bdun bdun te/ dang po lnga lnga ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyu/ bar du re re ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo bo/ tha ma re re ting nge 'dzin gyi 'bras bu'o/ /de ltar na nyi shu dang ldan na tshe 'di la grub mtha' snyogs/ bcu bzhi dang ldan na 'chi ka'am bar dor 'grub/ bdun dang ldan na bcu drug tshun chad la 'grub bo/ /sems gnas lugs gsum ni/ rlung sems bdag byin gyis brlabs pa zhes gsungs pa'i don ni/ rlung log pas sems gnas pa ni/ rta 'gro 'phro la bzung ba lta bu/ rlung sems bdag byin gyis brlabs pas sems gnas pa ni/ mar me chu la thigs pa'am/ dug gis rgyal ba lta bu/ rten mnyam du 'dres pas sems gnas pa ni/ chu la chu bzhag pa'am mar la mar bzhag pa ltar ting nge 'dzin phan tshun mi 'bral ba'o/ /thog mtha' gnyis 'og nas 'byung la/ 'dir rlung sems bdag byin gyis brlabs pa bstan to/ /da ni lung sgo bstun gyi dbang du byas nas/ byang chub kyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i chos sum cu rtsa bdun ltar lam bgrod na/ zhes gsungs te/ de'ang byang chub ni/ spangs pa dang ye shes/ phyogs kyi chos ni de'i rgyu/ sum cu rtsa bdun ni rten 'brel la rlung rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa sogs so bdun no/ /ces dmar bsod/ lus dran pa nye bar bzhag pa la sogs pa grangs nges pa rlung la rtsi'o/ /ting nge 'dzin 'gugs pa la myur bas sgom pa mi 'chor bas rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi ni/ zhes gsungs te/

sgom pa mi 'chor ba ni rin po che'i gser gyi gling bu phyin pa na gser mi 'chor ba ltar/ nang gi ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyu rkyen thams cad bdag nyid la 'grig pas sgom pa mi 'chor ba'o/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi ni/ sa rlung rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa la sogs pa bzhi'o/ /pha rol tu phyin pa sems gtsor sbyor bas dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi nas bsgom/ gsang sngags pa lus la rten 'brel sgrig pas rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi nas bsgom mo/ /de'ang las kyi rlung ni/ 'jig rten pa'i lam man chad du las bcu byed pa'o/ /de'ang spyir las kyi rlung 'jug pa bzhi/ rnam par dbye ba bcu/ nyams su blang ba'i gnad bdun/ man ngag gi gnad bdun bcu'o/ /de la dang po ni/ pho rlung gis 'phar/ mo rlung gis 'dar/ ma ning gi rlung gis brtan/ thod rgal ye shes kyi me 'bar bas 'phyong rgyug sna tshogs byed do/ /khams 'dus pa dang po ni pho brang 'dus pa bzhir rlung sems mkha' 'gro yab yum bcu sngar 'du ma myong ba 'dus pa'o/ /rlung so lag cha can gyi rtsa ral zhes bya ba ni/ dgun gyi rlung gis lus la du kha bskyed pa ltar khams 'dus pa dang po'i rlung gis kyang rtsa rlung gi zug bskyed pa'o/ /de'i tshe sems gnas pa sems nyams/ rta rmi ba ni/ rmi nyams nye bar mtshon pa'o/ /rtsa rlung gi zug 'byung ba lus nyams nye bar mtshon pa'o/ /de la rnam par dbye ba bcu ni/ rtsa ba'i rlung lnga dang / yan lag gi rlung lnga'o/ /nyams su blang ba'i gnad bdun ni rlung sbyor bdun ni la sogs kyi skabs so/ gong du bstan zin la/ man ngag gi gnad bdun cu ni/ sna tshogs 'dud sogs zhes bya ba gsungs te/ de'ang sna tshogs 'dud pa ni/ lus grub pa'i rtsa lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa thams cad 'dus pa yin pas/ sna tshogs 'dud pa sogs kyis sgras snying kha la sogs pa pho brang gzhan rnams bzung ngo / /gzhi rtsa ba'i rlung sogs bcu zin pa'i bye brag bdun gyis zhes bya ba ni/

rtsa ba'i rlung lnga dang / sogs kyi sgras yan lag gi rlung lnga ste bcu'o/ /rlung re re la yan lag bdun bdun yod pas man ngag gi gnad bcu bdun cu'o/ /de la rlung rnams kyis ming gang yin/ gnas gang na gnas/ las ci byed/ de zin pa'i zug ting nge 'dzin gang skye/ rengs pa'i skyon bcos pa'i thabs so/ /de la rtsa ba'i rlung lnga las/ sa rlung gi ming me dang gnas mnyam/ gnas lte ba/ las kha zas 'ju zhing dwangs snyigs 'byed pa la sogs pa byed/ zin pa'i zug stong lpo ba dang bur sgra la sogs pa 'byung / ting nge 'dzin bde stong skye/ rengs na dmu chu la sogs 'byung / bcos pa'i thabs la dor/ bde bar bsgom/ byin gyis brlab/ chu rlung gi ming srog 'dzin pa/ gnas snying kha/ las lus sems mi 'bral ba dang / nga dang bdag tu 'dzin/ zin pa'i zug snying 'chu zhing sprug ro stod gzer zhing na/ kha shugs 'bying pa la sogs pa 'byung / ting nge 'dzin stong gsal skye/ rengs na snying rlung la sogs pa 'byung / bcos pa'i thabs sngar dang 'dra/ me rlung gi ming gyen rgyu/ gnas mgrin pa/ las smra ba dang rgod pa dang kha zas phul zhing gyen du 'dren par byed/ zin pa'i zug mgrin pa prang zhing na/ ting nge 'dzin gsal bas gtso byas pa skye/ rengs na zas mid mi shes pa dang / lkugs pa la sogs par 'gyur/ bcos pa'i thabs 'dra/ rlung gi rlung la/ ming thur du rgyu ba/ gnas gsang gnas/ las sih+la ga dang ga pur dang / dri chen dri chu 'phen zhing 'dzin par byed/ zin pa'i zug bshang gci'i bar du gzer zhing zug dri chen dri chu mi thon pa dang mi sdoms pa la sogs pa 'byung / ting nge 'dzin bde ba shas cher skye/ rengs na ro smad lci zhing mi theg dri chen dri chu sdoms/ bcos pa'i thabs sngar dang 'dra/ nam mkha'i rlung la/ ming khyab byed/ gnas spyi bos gtso byas pa'i tshigs chen bcu gnyis/ las 'phyong ba dang rgyug pa dang 'degs pa dang 'jog pa la sogs pa byed/

zin pa la zug mgo dang tshigs chen rnams na zhing lji/ ting nge 'dzin gsal stong skye/ rengs na yan lag 'khum zhing sgur po la sogs par 'gyur/ bcos pa'i thabs sngar dang 'dra/ yan lag gi rlung lnga las/ mig gi rlung la mi rgyu ba/ gnas pa'i mig gi dbang po la/ /las gzugs rab 'bring gsum 'dzin/ zin pa la zug mig tsha zhing na/ ting nge 'dzin gzugs kyis mi gnod cing / gzugs kyi steng du ting nge 'dzin skye/ rengs na long ba la sogs par 'gyur/ bcos pa'i thabs sngar dang 'dra/ rna ba'i rlung la ming rab tu rgyu ba/ gnas rna ba'i dbang po la/ las sgra rab 'bring gsum 'dzin/ zin pa la zug rna ba gzer zhing 'ur ba 'byung / ting nge 'dzin sgras mi gnod cing sgra'i steng du ting nge 'dzin skye/ rengs na 'on pa dang rnag 'dzag pa la sogs pa 'byung / bcos pa'i thabs sngar dang 'dra/ sna'i rlung gi ming shin tu sgyu ba/ gnas sna'i dbang po la/ las dri rab 'bring gsum 'dzin/ zin pa la zug sna tsha zhing 'tshub pa la sogs pa 'byung / ting nge 'dzin dri yi gnod cing dri'i steng du ting nge 'dzin skye/ rengs na sna zhom drib dri mi tshor ba la sogs pa 'byung / bcos pa'i thabs sngar dang 'dra/ lce'i rlung la ming mngon par rgyu ba/ gnas lce'i dbang po la/ las ro rab 'bring gsum 'dzin/ zin pa la zug lce dang lce chung skrang zhing na/ ting nge 'dzin ros mi gnod cing ro'i steng du ting nge 'dzin skye/ rengs na ro mi tshor ba dang / skra dkar ba sogs pa 'byung / bcos pa'i thabs sngar dang 'dra/ lus kyi rlung la ming yang dag rgyu ba/ gnas ba spu skye ba'i phyogs kyi lpags pa la gnas/ las reg bya rab 'bring gsum 'dzin/ zin pa la zug lpags pa'i phyogs tsha zhing za ba la sogs pa 'byung / ting nge 'dzin reg bya'i mi gnod cing reg bya'i steng du ting nge 'dzin skye/ rengs na za 'brum dang shu ba la sogs par 'gyur/

bcos pa'i thabs sngar dang 'dra/ de la bcos pa'i thabs la dor ba gsum las/ rtsa de nyid kyi gnas su la dor ba ni/ rlung mi bzung bar gang na sar dmigs pa gtad nas rig pa sems kyis dzir non byas pas zhi'o/ /rlung rngan dgas byin te la dor ba ni/ rlung nang du rngubs nas gang na sar shes pas gtad de/ rtsol ba bkag la srog nas btang / des kyang ma phan na/ sems nyams kyi drod byung rgyal du la dor ba ni/ re shig dmigs pa btang snyoms su bzhag la/ yul sna tshogs kyi bdud rtsi rten/ gnyis pa bde ba bsgom pa ni/ steng du longs spyod kyi brlabs dang / 'og tu gsang ba'i snyoms 'jug gong du bshad pa bzhin no/ /gsum pa byin gyis brlabs pa la drug las/ bla ma dam pa'i byin brlabs ni/ gang na sar stong par bsgoms la/ der nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan stengs su bdag la dges bzhin pa bzhugs par bsgoms la gsol ba gdab/ gnyis pa lhag pa lha'i byin brlabs ni/ na sar yi dam gyi lha bsgoms la ye shes sems dpa' yang yang stibs byas la gsol ba gdab/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sgom pa'i phyag len yang mdzad/ gsum pa phyi nang mkha' 'gro'i byin brlabs ni/ mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bya'o/ /bzhi pa mdo rgyud zab mo'i byin brlabs ni/ mdo sde dang rgyud sde zab cing rgya che ba dang / stobs zab mo rang gis lta ba gzhan klog tu bcug pa la'ang mnyan/ yang na de dag gi tshig zab mo thor bu ba rnams bris la yid la bzung / lnga pa snang ba la sogs kyi byin brlabs ni/ re shig dmigs pa btang snyoms su bzhag la snang ba sna tshogs la longs spyod cing nyin zhag ci rigs par ci bder sdod/ drug pa rten 'brel zab mo'i byin brlabs ni/ lus kyi 'phrul 'khor dang / sems kyi dmigs pa la sogs pa 'dir yi ge mang gis dogs nas ma bris pas/ gegs sel gyi skabs su shes par bya'o/ /yan lag gi rlung rim kyis nang du 'gag

ces pa ni/ ril ba zhabs tsags can gyi bu ga gcig bkag pas gzhan nas chu mi 'dzag pa ltar rtsa ba'i rlung lnga 'gags pas/ yan lag gi rlung rim gyis nang du 'gag thig le mang du kha 'bu/ zhes pa ni/ rlung log pas gtum mo'i me 'bar/ des rtsa mdud bral/ de nas zho bsrubs pa'i mar ltar ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyu thig le mang du kha 'bu'o/ /rten pa mnyam gnas su 'dres ba ni/ rtsa rin po che'i pho brang du/ gzhir gnas pa'i byang chub kyi sems dang / mas byon pa'i byang chub kyi sems dam tshig sa dang ye shes pa'i tshul du 'dres pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye'o/ /de la rten nas sems nang du gnas pa sems rnam par rtog pa'i rjes su mi 'gro bar mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin du gyur pa'o/ /de'i stobs kyis mig la sogs pa yul gyi rjes su mi 'brang bas/ rnam shes lnga 'dus de dag gis ting nge 'dzin skye ba'i rgyu dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo bo bstan to/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi phan yon ni/ phung po lnga dul zhes gsungs te/ nyon mongs pa blo bur ba bzlog gang la'ang zhen pa chung / 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad dang bral/ phyi nang gi srin bu rim gyis spong / gnyen lcug bzhi rim gyis 'char te rkang pa'i mthe bong gtsugs nas langs kyang / mi bde ba med pa lus sku'i gnyen lcug rtsa yi ge stag la sogs par sprul nas rlung sems drangs pas bdag kyang de'i gzugs su ston nus pa yi ge'i gnyen lcug khams bdud rtsi dwangs par byas nas gang du yid gtad pa de shes pa'i mngon par shes pa ni khams bdud rtsi'i gnyen lcug gang na sar yid gtad de rlung phyung bas na thams cad sel ba rlung gi gnyen lcug ye shes kyi 'gro ldog byed/ ces pa ni khams 'dus pa dang po la rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes skye yang rnam rtog gi dbang byed pas mi rtog pa'i ye shes stobs chung bas ye shes 'gro ldog gam/ ye shes rnam rtog gi dbang du song ba'i dus zhes bya/

da ni ting nge 'dzin skye ba'i tshul rnams drod gsum gyi bye brag gis bsdus nas bstan pa'i phyir/ bsgom pa mi 'chor ba'i mthong snang rmi lam nyams gsum gsum ni/ zhes bya ba'i don ni mthong snang du ba la sogs pa/ rmi lam rta rmi ba la sogs pa nyams rtsa rlung gi zug la sogs pa lus nyams so/ /gsum gsum ni/ rnam rtog sngon du song ba/ khams dgu 'dus pa/ thig le 'bar zhing brtan pa/ gsum pa mthong snang / rmi lam nyams gsum gyi phye bas ting nge 'dzin dgu phrugs su skye'o/ /rnam rtog sngon du song ba ltar khams gsum kun tu snang ngo / /zhes bya ba'i don ni/ rnam rtog sngon du song ba la ting nge 'dzin skye ba'i tshul gsum yod pa ltar gzhan gnyis la'ang sbyar bas dgu'o/ /khams gsum kun tu snang ba ni khams gsum ni bsrung ba gzhan thams cad mi dmigs par ting nge 'dzin nyid du snang ba'o/ /da ni lam khrid lugs gsum las rlung gis lam khrid pa rgyas par bstan pa la/ 'byung ba lnga rang gi gnas su zin pa'i nyams/ 'byung ba lnga stobs 'phel ba'i nyams/ rlung 'byung ba bzhir cha mnyam pa ste zin pa'i nyams/ 'byung chung bcu drug cha mnyam ste zin pa'i nyams bzhi las/ dang po ni/ sa chu la thim na mig sgyu zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pa'i don ni/ lte ba'i sa rlung gi nus pa/ snying kha'i chu rlung la thim na rmig sgyu/ snying kha'i chu mgrin pa'i me la thim na du ba mgrin pa'i me gsang gnas kyi rlung la thim na srin bu me khyer/ gsang gnas kyi rlung rnam par shes pa la thim na mar me 'bar ba rnam par shes pa nam mkha'i rlung gi gnas spyi bor thim na nam mkha' sprin med lta bu ste/ de rnams nyams ci rigs su 'char ro/ /de rnams rtsa dbu ma cung zad thim na rtags thams cad shin tu gsal zhing brtan pas 'byung ngo / /thim pa'i don grangs thim pa/ tshad thim pa/ nus pa thim pa'o/ /grangs thim pa ni/ lte ba'i sa rlung dgu brgya phrag gcig snying kha'i chu rlung gis dbang byas pa lta bu yin/

tshad thim pa ni/ sa rlung sor bcu drug chu rlung sor bcu gnyis kyi dbang byas pa lta bu yin/ nus pa thim pa ni/ sa rlung sra ba'i rang bzhin chu rlung bsher ba'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'o/ /gnyis pa 'byung ba lnga stobs 'phel ba'i nyams ni/ sa chu me rlung dang rlung sems mnyam par 'dus na/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i don ni gzhir gnas pa dang / yas byon pa'i rlung sems dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa'i tshul gyis 'dres na/ 'byung ba lnga'i nyams 'char ba las/ thog mar me rlung stobs 'phel ba la khams gsum kun tu me 'bar ba ltar snang / zhes gsungs pa ni mthong snang dang rmi nyams su grong khyer mes tshig pa la sogs pa 'byung / gnyis shugs las 'byung ba ni/ lus nyams su tsha/ sems nyams su me chen po'am/ tsha bas gdung ba snyam byed pa 'byung / chu rlung dang spu lus grang zhes bya ba ni/ chu rlung stobs 'phel na/ lus nyams su spu lus grang ci gyon yang mi dros/ gzhan gsum po shugs la 'byung ba ni/ sems nyams su gangs bar dang bu yug gi nang na gnas pa snyam byed/ rmi nyams su rgya mtsho chen po la gru 'dzugs pa la sogs pas byung / mthong snang du rgya mtsho bzhi mthong / rlung gi rlung 'du 'phro dang rang 'phur bya 'byung zhes pa ni/ rlung gi rlung stobs 'phel na/ sems nyams su sems 'du 'phro mang / rmi nyams su rang 'phur ba dang / bya'i tshogs kyis gnyid sprog pa 'byung / gzhan gnyis shugs la 'byung ba ni/ lus nyams su yang shing rta ltar 'gyogs/ mthong snang du/ 'og rlung gi dkyil 'khor mthong ba la sogs pa 'byung / gzhung las sa zhes gsungs pa'i don rgyas par bshad na/ sa rlung stobs 'phel bas/ lus nyams su lus ljid zhing bskyod par dka'/ sems nyams su khur chen po khur nas/ thang chen po la mi nus bzhin du 'gro ba snyam byed/ rmi nyams su ri bos non pa la sogs pa 'byung / mthong snang du gser gyi ri bdun dang gser gyi sa gzhi mthong ba la sogs pa 'byung /

nam mkha'i rlung stobs su gyur pa las 'og gi gzhung nas/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa dang spu lus bde/ zhes pa 'dir grangs nas/ lus nyams su spu lus bde/ du kha'i rkyen gyis mi gnod/ gzhan gsum shugs la 'byung ba ni/ sems nyams su stong pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye/ rmi nyams su nam mkha' la 'phur ba dang / gang la'ang mi thogs pa rmi/ mthong snang du stong gsum gyi nam mkha' mthong ba 'byung ngo / /de dag gis ni me rlung gi nyams mthong snang la sbyar/ chu rlung dang nam mkha'i rlung lus nyams la sbyar/ rlung gi rlung sems nyams la sbyar/ sa rlung gi nyams de dag gi shugs las rtogs par dgongs/ de ltar na thams cad snyoms pas 'byung ba lnga'i nyams thams cad tshang bar go bas gzhung rtsom pa'i tshul shin tu ngo mtshar gsung / gsum pa 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung cha mnyam pa'i nyams ni/ 'byung ba'i rlung mnyam rgyu dang lha mo sna tshogs kyis gar mchod/ ces gsungs pa'i don/ 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga pa bzhi/ mgon po'i rlung dgu brgya phrag gcig tu zin na/ phyi rol tu mthong snang dang / rmi nyams su lha mo sna tshogs kyis gar gyis mchod de/ de'ang sa rlung gis gtso byas na spyan dang de'i rigs kyi lha mos glu dang gar gyis mchod pa dang / chu rlung gis gtso byas na ma ma ki'i mchod pa'ang de dang mtshungs par shes par bya'o/ /'di la lus nyams gtso chung bas ma gsungs so/ /bzhi pa 'byung chung bcu drug tu cha mnyam pa'i nyams ni/ 'byung bzhi'i rlung sna tshogs dang dri ro/ zhes gsungs te/ 'pho ba gnyis kyi rlung brgyad brgya pa phrag gnyis zin pas/ phyi rol du sa gtso che bas stong gsum gyi dri sna tshogs dang / chu las ro me las gzugs/ rlung las reg bya sna tshogs las longs spyod pa 'byung / 'di lus nyams gtso che bas gnad gnyis po gzhan po ma smos so/ /'di dag gi mtshan nyid sna tshogs su skye ba'i ting nge 'dzin yin la/

rang bzhin stong pa dang ngo bo zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin yang rim pa yin min du skye bas byung rgyal du skyang ngo / /'jig rten pa'i rlung gis lam khrid pa bstan zin to/ /gnyis pa khams bdud rtsi'i lam khrid pa ni/ bdud rtsi lnga dang de bzhin gshegs sku sogs/ zhes gsungs pa'i don/ bdud rtsi lnga shin tu dwangs pa'i rten 'brel gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga/ 'bring du dwangs pas de dag gi rigs byang chub sems dpa' rnam pa/ tha mar dwangs pas 'od kha dog lnga la sogs par mthong / sih+la dang nyi ma zhes bya ba gsang gnas su ma las thob pa'i rak+ta 'phel na/ mthong snang dang rmi nyams su stong gsum gyi nyi ma mthong ba dang / lus la 'od kha dog dmar po bskor ba la sogs pa 'byung / ga pur dang zla ba zhes bya ba/ smin mtshams su pha las thob pa'i byang chub kyi sems 'phel na/ mthong snang dang rmi nyams su stong gsum gyi zla ba mthong ba dang / lus la 'od kha dog dkar po bskor ba la sogs pa 'byung / rtsa phran rnams su thig phran dang skar ma zhes bya ba/ rtsa phran stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis su thig le phra mo 'phel na/ mthong snang dang rmi nyams su stong gsum gyi skar ma mthong ba dang / lus las kyang skar ma 'char ba 'byung ngo / /'dir yang mtshan nyid sna tshogs la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gsum po rim pa yin min du skye bas byung rgyal du skyang ngo / /'jig rten pa'i khams bdud rtsis lam khrid la bstan zin to/ /gsum pa rtsa dang yi ges lam khrid pa la gsum las/ yi ge phal pas lam khrid pa ni/ rtsa 'dzin sogs su shing sdong sogs/ zhes gsungs te/ rtsa 'dzin chen po dbu ma ro rkyang gis gcer bas der rlung sems mnyam par 'dus na ri dang brag rtsa 'dzin chung ngu ro rkyang la gzhan gyis gcer ba'i gnas su rlung sems mnyam par gnas shing sdong bkas pa'i bar du lus gcer ba'i gnang ba byung / chags sdang rnam pa lnga dang zhes pa ni/

snying kha'i hūm̐ la sogs pa nyon mongs pa lnga'i yi ge rlung sems mnyam par 'dus na bdag gi rgyud la nyon mongs pa lnga rang 'byung du skye/ gzhan rgyud la skye bar snang / nyon mongs pa lnga'i rnam pa 'joms pa mthong ste/ 'dod chags kyi dug 'thag zhe sdang gi me bsod/ gti mug gi mun pa sel/ nga rgyal gyi ri bo bsnyil/ ser sna'i mdud pa 'grol/ phrag dog gi sgo lcags 'byed pa mthong ngo / /nyams nga mya ngan 'dre'i rtsa/ zhes bya ba ni/ nyams nga ba'i rtsa mkhal ma'i nang bskor la gnas te/ der rlung sems 'dus na/ nyams gsum ka la mi dang mi ma yin pas 'jigs shing ya nga ba 'byung / lus nyams su nyams nga ba'i rnam 'gyur byed pa 'byung / mya ngan gyi rtsa ni/ rkang pa'i mthe bong gnyis la gtso bo'i tshul du gnas/ lag pa'i mthe bong gnyis la phal pa'i tshul du gnas/ de dag tu rlung sems 'dus na nyams gsum ka la mya ngan rang 'byung du skye'o/ /'dre'i rtsa ni/ lag pa'i ming med gnyis la gtso bor gnas/ rkang pa'i ming med gnyis la phal pa'i tshul du gnas/ der rlung sems 'dus na khams gsum ka la 'dre'i snang ba 'byung / mthong snang la'ang 'dre sna tshogs mthong zhing 'dres gnod pa byed pa 'byung / mchi ma'i rtsar g.yal dang mchi ma/ zhes bya ba ni/ mkhal ma'i phyi logs gnyis dang / mig rtsa 'khyil ba gnyis la gnas/ der rlung sems 'dus na lus nyams 'ba' zhig la g.yal dang mchil ma mang du 'byung ngo / /de dag kyang mtshan nyid sna tshogs su skye zhing / gzhan nyams gnyis po'ang rim pa yin min du skye bas drod byung rgyal du bskyang ngo / /de ltar na mig phal pas lam khrid pa bstan zin to/ /gnyis pa yi ge'i gtso bo bcu bzhis lam khrid pa ni/ yi ge bcu bzhi po 'di rnams rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs mi 'dra ba la dgongs nas gsang ba 'dus pa'i lugs kyi spyi bo/ rdo rje gdan bzhi'i lugs kyi snying kha/ sam bhu ṭi las tshigs chen la/

dus 'khor dang bde mchog pa gsang gnas/ dges pas rdo rje bas lte bar gnas par bzhed/ de'ang slob dpon gyi dgongs pas/ dges rdor bde mchog dgongs pas phyogs gcig du mdzad nas lte ba man chad nas gsang gnas kyi 'khor lo yan chad la gnas par bzhed de/ lte bar dang por chags pa rigs drug gi yi ger rlung sems mnyam par 'dus na rigs drug gi gar sngags der khrid pa rmi lam nyams lta bu khams gsum kun tu snang ngo / /zhes gsungs pa'i don la chos bdun te/ yi ge rnams kyi gnas/ ming / kha dog khams gsum du dbye ba/ 'khor 'das gsum du dbye ba/ nyams gsum du dbye ba/ nyon mongs pa ltar dbye ba'o/ /de la dang po gsum gyi phyogs gcig tu brjod na/ lte ba'i g.yas na lha'i a yig dkar po/ de'i 'og tu mi'i nri yig sngon po/ g.yon du lha ma yin gyi su yig ser po/ de'i 'og tu yi dwags kyi pre yig dmar po/ gsang gzhan kyi rtsa gsum po 'doms bar dud 'gro'i dud yig du kha/ de'i 'og tu dmyal ba'i dre yig nag po/ lha dang mi'i yi ge'i bar du bsam gtan gyi aṃ dkar po/ lha ma yin dang yi dwags kyi yi ge'i bar du shes rab kyi dmar po/ dud 'gro dang dmyal ba'i yi ge'i bar du zung 'jug gi hūm̐ sngon po/ yi dwags kyi pre yig gi g.yon zur gyi 'og tu snying po'i a dkar po/ dmyal ba'i yi ge'i 'og tu phyi dbyibs kyi a dkar po/ de'i 'og tu srin po'i k+ṣa yig ljang khu/ de'i 'og tu stobs kyi hūm̐ yig sngon po mgo thur lta/ de'i 'og tu drag po'i phaṭ dmar nag mgo gyen lta/ de'ang lam du byed pa'i tshe k+ṣa dmar nag tu bsgom/ phaṭ ljang khur bsgom/ snying po'i a'i 'og tu yon tan gyi rtsa khyi mo nyal ba lta bu/ de'i 'og tu yon tan gyi rtsa g.yer ma kha bye ba lta bu/ de las bag chags dang 'brel ba'i rtsa brgyad gyes so/ /bzhi pa khams gsum du dbye na bsam gtan gyi oṃ gzugs khams/
